semantics.mechanism: Trades the TRANSITION of ATR across its moving average (not a squeeze breakout): expand-onset -> ride the move, contract-onset -> revert to mean.
semantics.signal_reason: Onset of ATR crossing above (expand) or below (contract) its mean; expand rides the ROC direction, contract reverts toward the SMA; enter next open.

entry.description: Onset of ATR crossing back below its own moving average; direction reverts toward the mean.

exit.description: 24-bar time-stop (frozen engine's own exit=time convention); no price target.

risk_model.stop_floor: executable risk = max(2*spread_ticks*tick, 5*tick, 0.10*ATR) = max(0.20, 0.50, 0.10*ATR) price units (v2, pre-registered)
risk_model.costs: (spread 1 + slippage 1) ticks/side * 0.1 = 0.10/side; 0.20 round-trip charged in R

position_sizing.stop_floor: executable risk = max(2*spread_ticks*tick, 5*tick, 0.10*ATR) = max(0.20, 0.50, 0.10*ATR) price units (v2, pre-registered)
position_sizing.costs: (spread 1 + slippage 1) ticks/side * 0.1 = 0.10/side; 0.20 round-trip charged in R
position_sizing.concurrency: ONE position at a time (overlapping signals suppressed until the open trade closes)
position_sizing.absolute_size: lot = per-trade risk budget / risk-distance — an EXECUTION-LAYER decision, NOT set by the research
